title.narrative: JPO (Republic of Korea) for Youth Programme (SHS/REI/YOU)

description.narrative: The JPO will be working under the overall authority of the Assistant Director-General for Social and Human Sciences (ADG/SHS), and under the direct supervision of the Chief of the Youth Section. Within the frameworks of UNESCO's Medium-Term Strategy (C/4), the approved Programme and Budget (C/5), and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the key objective of the Youth Programme is to strengthen the capacities of youth stakeholders, to generate knowledge, and to support youth actions, networks, and spaces, so as to help develop and implement youth-focused policies and programmes addressing multidimensional societal challenges faced by youth. To achieve this, the work of the Youth Section is developed around four key building blocks: (i) Youth-led Knowledge (ii) Policy solutions (iii) Youth-led action and innovation iv) Capacity development. The Youth Section also coordinates Youth as a UNESCO priority group.
